direction: Human faces are plain, with eyes, nose and mouth removed. Hair, clothing, anatomy and poses retained. Animal creature faces preserved.

prompts.people: Edit the supplied game asset sheet. SINGLE REQUEST: make EVERY HUMAN FACE completely FACELESS / FEATURELESS. Remove all eyes, eyebrows, eyelids, noses, nostrils, lips, mouth lines, teeth and facial expression marks from EVERY pose and EVERY portrait. Replace the face area with a clean uninterrupted smooth matte skin-colored plane with only very gentle broad watercolor shading, like a tasteful faceless wooden illustration figure. No eye sockets, no nose bridge shadows, no mouth indentation. Smooth the nose profile into a simple oval face contour. Preserve each person's skin tone, hairstyle, hairline, ears, beard silhouette, head size, neck, clothing, hands, weapons, equipment, body anatomy, pose and painterly hand-drawn style. The beard may remain as a solid hair shape but never define a mouth. Do NOT add a mask, bandage, visor, new accessory, smile or decorative face mark. Preserve EXACTLY the same number of sprites/portraits, same order, layout, relative coordinates, scale, spacing, crop and canvas aspect ratio. Do not move, enlarge or rearrange anyone. Keep the transparent background and gutters; for the portrait sheet remove its colored background completely to genuine alpha, leaving eight individually isolated complete busts. All image pixels outside faces/background should match the reference as closely as possible. No text or labels. Every single human face in the sheet must be blank.
prompts.humanoidEnemies: Edit this game sprite atlas without changing the layout, number of sprites, identities, poses, equipment, clothing, scale or spacing. Make the HUMAN and HUMANOID faces featureless: remove their eyes, glowing eye dots, eyebrows, nose forms, nostrils, mouths, lips, skull-face sockets and expression lines. Exposed human faces become smooth blank matte skin planes. Human-shaped masks or helmets have smooth uninterrupted faceplates with no eye holes or mouth slits, preserving their surrounding helmet design. Hooded human faces become a plain dark featureless oval. Preserve every animal/monster beast face (boars, wolves, reptiles, dragons, birds, slugs, insects and other nonhuman creatures) exactly as they are: this change is for human-shaped characters only. Keep beautiful detailed hand-drawn ink/gouache artwork elsewhere, all complete silhouettes and original exact atlas order. Remove the colored matte/gradient background if any; output genuine transparent RGBA empty air between every sprite, no checkerboard painting, no floor/shadows, no text. Do not rearrange, resize or add sprites.
